q: What was life expectancy for women in 2019 to 2020?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvad var middel-levetiden for kvinder i 2019-2020?

learn.text: Life expectancy is, in 2024 to 2025, 83.9 years for women and 80.3 years for men.

da.q: Hvor lang var middellevetiden for mænd i 2020-2021?

learn.text: Life expectancy is, in 2024 to 2025, 83.9 years for women and 80.3 years for men.

q: How old must you be to buy cigarettes in Denmark?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021, May 2024 and May 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvor gammel skal man være for at købe cigaretter i Danmark?

learn.text: For example you must be 16 years old to buy beer in the shops, with an alcohol content of between 1.2 and 6 percent, and 18 years to buy cigarettes, strong beer, wine and strong spirits, with an alcohol content of 6.6 percent and above.

q: How old must you at least be to buy strong spirits?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2023 and November 2024 exams.

da.q: Hvor gammel skal man mindst være for at købe stærk spiritus?

learn.text: For example you must be 16 years old to buy beer in the shops, with an alcohol content of between 1.2 and 6 percent, and 18 years to buy cigarettes, strong beer, wine and strong spirits, with an alcohol content of 6.6 percent and above.
